fields.name: return_history
fields.title: Return History
fields.description: Return reusable native conversations with original image parts and provider thought signatures. Uses a native provider. Each generated conversation is independent; send its messages as history for the next turn.

fields.name: thinking_level
fields.title: Thinking Level
fields.description: Thinking effort. Pro Image supports only high; omit to retain its provider default. An explicit level requests summaries unless include_thoughts overrides it. Thinking cannot be disabled.

fields.name: image_passthrough
fields.title: Image Passthrough
fields.description: Send reference images and return provider images without resizing or re-encoding, preserving transparency and metadata. Uses direct Google or Vertex APIs; the returned image format may differ from output_format.

fields.name: include_thoughts
fields.title: Include Thoughts
fields.description: Whether to include thought summaries. Omit to preserve the existing behavior: an explicit thinking_level requests summaries. Set limit_generations=false to return summary text in description. This does not disable thinking or return intermediate thought images.

fields.name: temperature
fields.title: Temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature. Omit to use the provider default of 1. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

fields.name: top_p
fields.title: Top P
fields.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Omit to use the provider default of 0.95. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

fields.name: max_output_tokens
fields.title: Max Output Tokens
fields.description: Maximum output tokens for the generation. Omit to retain the provider default. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: The seed for the random number generator.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image, including 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The format of the generated image.

fields.name: safety_tolerance
fields.title: Safety Tolerance
fields.description: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

fields.name: system_prompt
fields.title: System Prompt
fields.description: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers).

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: The resolution of the image to generate.

fields.name: limit_generations
fields.title: Limit Generations
fields.description: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate.

fields.name: enable_web_search
fields.title: Enable Web Search
fields.description: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.
